name: Cream of Rice

low.description: About 1/4 cup dry or 3/4 cup cooked

siboNotes: Excellent choice for SIBO as it's easily digestible and free of fermentable carbohydrates. Well-tolerated during bacterial overgrowth phases.
preparationTips: Cook with lactose-free milk or water to maintain low FODMAP status
Add maple syrup or brown sugar instead of honey for sweetening
Start with smaller portions if you have severe digestive sensitivity
Can be made ahead and reheated with additional liquid
nutritionalHighlights: Low in fiber, gentle on sensitive stomachs
